motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Routine consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of routine items passed together in a single vote without separate discussion.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents. The motion as recorded doesn't list which items were in the batch.

motions.item_title: Remand the Ordinance Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Title 6 and Title 17 to Establi…
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to remand the Ordinance Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Title 6 and Title 17 to Establish Standards for Alternative Animal Management Plans and Update Related Zoning Provisions back to the Planning Commission to review additional changes. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Animal rules sent back to Planning Commission
motions.summary: The council sent proposed rules on alternative animal management plans, and the related zoning changes, back to the Planning Commission for more review.
motions.impact: If you keep animals on your property, nothing changes yet. The proposal goes back for revisions and would have to return to the council before any new rules take effect.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta). Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Development deal for Meta's project
motions.summary: The city approved a development agreement with Stadion, LLC, the company name Meta uses locally, setting the terms for its project here.
motions.impact: This sets the ground rules Meta has to build under. The motion lists no dollar figures, acreage or timeline, so it doesn't tell you what you'll see or pay.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Third Amendment to the Water and Sewer Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Third Amendment to the Water and Sewer Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta). Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Change the water and sewer deal with Meta
motions.summary: The city approved a third amendment to its water and sewer agreement with Stadion, LLC, the company name Meta uses locally.
motions.impact: The motion doesn't spell out what the amendment changes, so nothing here says your water service or bill is affected. It matters most if you follow the city's water arrangements with Meta.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Meritage Homes at Harmony Subdivision
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Meritage Homes at Harmony Subdivision. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Development deal for Harmony subdivision
motions.summary: The city approved a development agreement with homebuilder Meritage Homes covering the Harmony subdivision.
motions.impact: The agreement locks in the terms Meritage has to build to. Nothing changes day to day for current residents — it matters mainly if you live near the site or plan to buy there.
